items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: we went on tour with the Birdland stars of 1955, which was the Basie band, Sarah Vaughan, Lester Young, Stan Getz, Erroll Garner, Bud Powell

ctx.x: I joined the band the day after Christmas in New York here, and we went on a southern tour. And Frank Foster and Ernie Wilkins, we got together in Jacksonville, Florida at a place called the Two Spot I think it was then. And we were down there about three or four days in one place. And they made the arrangements on “Every Day I Have the Blues,” “The Comeback,” “Teach Me Tonight.” And we came to Washington, D.C., rehearsed that morning in the Howard Theater and performed that evening, that afternoon and that…
“Alright O.K. You Win” that was on there?
